messages:
From: Terry Huang <terry.huang@lumeno.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: priya@lumeno.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Governed Onboarding — Critical Path & Ownership Commitments

Hi Grace / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Lumeno is excited to move forward. Before we lock signatures, leadership asked for a compact "critical path" mutual action plan (MAP) that:

- Identifies the blockers that would push our go-live out beyond December 2026
- Assigns clear owners for each milestone
- Commits to agreed signoff dates and delivery windows

Attached is the first-pass SOW and our internal onboarding checklist. Can your team confirm who will own: data schema freeze, staging API access, pre-go-live validation, and the final production cutover window?

Attachments (stubs):
- SOW_Lumeno_v1.pdf (pdf, 364 KB)
- Lumeno_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 78 KB)

We propose the following target dates but are flexible if Redwood needs to shift:
- Data schema freeze: 2026-11-01
- Staging integration complete: 2026-11-22
- Validation & acceptance: 2026-12-08
- Production cutover: 2026-12-15

Appreciate a concise MAP that we can circulate to our stakeholders.

Best,
Terry Huang
Head of Integrations, Lumeno Health
terry.huang@lumeno.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Governed Onboarding — Critical Path & Ownership Commitments

Terry — thanks for the clear ask. I created a compact critical-path MAP below and attached a short RACI workbook for us to iterate on (Onboarding-RACI.xlsx). Please confirm the Lumeno signoff dates and whether you can share a read-only staging host by 2026-11-10.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Data schema freeze — owner: Lumeno / Lumeno data team; Redwood support: Karthik (engineering contact)
  - Target: 2026-11-01 (Lumeno signoff required)
- Staging API credentials & initial sync — owner: Redwood infra (Karthik) / Lumeno eng (Priya)
  - Target: credentials provisioned by 2026-11-10; initial sync complete by 2026-11-22
- Pre-go-live validation (test harness + business validation) — owner: Lumeno QA / Redwood CS (Marissa)
  - Target: 2026-12-08 (acceptance checklist signoff)
- Cutover window & rollback plan — owner: Redwood ops (Ben) / Lumeno ops (Terry)
  - Target: production cutover 2026-12-15; rollback window defined in SOW page 6
- Post-go-live success metrics & SLA review — owner: Redwood CS (Marissa)
  - Target: review 30 days after cutover (2027-01-14)

Immediate asks for Lumeno:
1) Confirm the data schema freeze date (2026-11-01) and provide a link to your canonical schema.
2) Confirm Priya can be the staging contact and will accept our access request by 2026-11-08.
3) Accept the RACI workbook or propose changes by 2026-10-12 so we can lock owners.

Attachment stubs referenced:
- Onboarding-RACI.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)
- SOW_Lumeno_v1.pdf (pdf, 364 KB)

If the dates above look tight, indicate which milestone we should relax first (staging vs. validation) and we'll propose alternatives. Will circulate a one-page MAP after your confirmation.

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Thanks — quick engineering alignment and a couple items that will affect the critical path:

1) Data schema freeze: we need the canonical schema and any backward-compatible migration notes by 2026-10-28 to meet the 2026-11-01 freeze date. If Lumeno can't deliver by 10/28, plan moves +2 weeks.

2) Staging access: Redwood will provision a staging host, but Priya must complete the access form and share the initial client certificate (see Drive link). I'll schedule an API onboarding call for 2026-11-11 to walk through token rotation and rate limits.

3) Cutover / rollback: Ben and I discussed a soft-cutover approach (traffic mirroring) for the first 48 hours. We need Lumeno signoff on the monitoring thresholds in the attached SOW.

DocuSign: I'm tagging the SOW for signature today — please review the final redline here: https://docusign.com/AMS/EnvelopeID12345

If the DOC deliverables above are met on the suggested cadence, engineering is aligned to the dates in Grace's MAP. Otherwise, notify the group with which milestone to reprioritize.

Thanks — Karthik
